title: Observational field visit
description: The setting, activities and workarounds observed in context, environmental factors, pain points and opportunities.

summary.description: Three to five sentences on what the session covered and what matters most.

setting.description: The kind of place and situation observed, without names or addresses (e.g. "a small warehouse during the morning shift").

activities.description: Activities observed, in the order they happened.

actors.description: Who did it, by role or pseudonym.

toolsAndArtefacts.description: Tools, systems, documents or objects used.

observations.description: How it was done, including sequence, timing and interruptions.

workarounds.description: Improvised fixes or deviations from the official process, and what they compensate for.

environmentalFactors.description: Physical, social or organisational conditions that shaped the work (noise, interruptions, policies).

notableQuotes.description: The most telling quotes, most telling first. At most 10.

timestamp.description: Approximate position in the recording (mm:ss or h:mm:ss), if known.

opportunities.description: Design or process opportunities that follow from the observations.
